english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on ambition and striving for advancement, especially in work or business.
Use this for a person whose ambition is viewed positively as enterprising and self-improving.

examples.english: They are very enterprising at work and actively seek promotion every year.
examples.traditional: 佢做嘢好進取，年年都主動爭取升職。

examples.english: They’re ambitious and even study after work.
examples.traditional: 佢好進取，放工後仲去讀書。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 zeon3 ceoi2 fong3 gung1 hau6 zung6 heoi3 duk6 syu1

english.note: Use this for an aggressive investment or business strategy aiming for high returns despite higher risk.

examples.english: This fund has a more aggressive investment strategy.
examples.traditional: 呢隻基金嘅投資策略比較進取。
